matched_visual_check.method: Direct sRGB metrics over rows 140 through 259 of the identical 1280x720 breaking_water_side camera. Gradient magnitude combines adjacent horizontal and vertical luminance differences; edge fraction uses magnitude greater than 0.08.
matched_visual_check.verdict: Retain as a bounded structural and material correction, not as a numeric edge-density win. V2 fixes the audited V1 station-253 m coverage defect, populates the full 600 m runnable corridor, and replaces one square detail projection with a world-space-selected 124/217-scale pair whose second projection is rotated 37 degrees. The fixed close-up confirms fine grounded gravel, short cover, and non-square color variation at station 300 m. The same-camera aggregate edge fraction is 1.97 percent lower than V1, so this review does not claim increased global edge density or photoreal acceptance.
